title: Garland of Glory
program_note:
A Garland of Glory is a setting of a portion of the Friday night Reform liturgy.  It was written for soprano, organ and two hand-clappers, but the forces necessary to perform this work are flexible. The work may be performed with only one hand-clapper, or without the hand-clap parts entirely. Furthermore, if she so desires, the soprano may play one of the clapping lines while singing. Piano may also be substituted for the organ part.

David S. Lefkowitz

Philadelphia, PA
